born.name: Roger Keith Coleman
born.cause: prior to execution by electrocution. In 2006, Coleman was found to be truly guilty due to DNA evidence
born.last_words: An innocent man is going to be murdered tonight. When my innocence is proven, I hope America will realize the injustice of the death penalty as all other civilized countries have. My last words are to the woman I love. Love is eternal. My love for you will last forever. I love you, Sharon.
